name: smwmusic-rent-a-hero-main-theme-space-harrier
title: Rent A Hero - Main Theme (Space Harrier)
description:
A short version of the Space Harrier main theme found in the Mega Drive action-adventure game Rent A Hero. It's better known as the intro music for Sonic Retro.

This port is created as global, but there's an alternative version that uses different instruments for non-global use, and an option for putting in the goal whistle. Follow the instructions found in .txt file for how to implement them.
